text:
mel: Heads-up — Customer H wants a compact "advisor" deliverable: concrete batching/caching/quant recommendations + eval-triggered alerts and clear launch gates. Q2 ask. Who can own the spec?
aj: I can take the spec lead. Quick question: do we bake per-model quant profiles or make per-workload heuristics the default?
sophia: Per-workload IMO. Customer workload shapes (seq length, prompt patterns) change benefits. Default heuristics + per-customer overrides. Also +1 on eval-triggered alerts.
ryan: Agree. Also we need a fallback policy: if quant path causes >2% quality regress on eval set -> auto-fallback to float path and alert. How do we want to present that to customers?
tanya: Launch gates proposal (draft):
  1) Automated eval pass vs customer prompt-set: quality delta <=0.5%
  2) Measured perf improvement >=20% throughput or cost/unit >=15%
  3) Console: token-level before/after diff + rollout controls
  4) Canary: 5% traffic for 48h with alerting/abort
mel: Good list. Metrics we should standardize: MRR for ranking tasks, exact-match for extraction, perplexity for generation; and latency p50/p95. Keep gates metric-driven.
aj: Early config sketch (for conversation):
```
advisor:
  batching:
    mode: adaptive
    target_latency_ms: 80
  caching:
    kv_prefix: enabled
    ttl_seconds: 300
  quant:
    profiles: ["int8-dp", "int8-symmetric"]
    revert_threshold_pct: 2.0
```
sophia: Nice. Add QA checklist: synthetic load tests, adversarial prompt set, eval drift detection, regression alert hooks tied to SLOs and eval-triggered alerts. Also include non-regression on hallucination-sensitive prompts.
ryan: I will wire the canary monitors: compare baseline vs new path on quality metrics and latency. Need owners for rollout docs + customer comms.
tanya: I can draft the customer pilot comms + FAQ. We should include clear rollback instructions and what to expect in metrics.
deploy-bot: canary-policy: 5% -> 25% over 48h if no quality regressions flagged. Auto-abort on >2% regression or manual abort.
mel: Owners: aj = spec + docs, tanya = customer comms + pilot ops, ryan = canary infra and monitors, sophia = eval & QA. Timeline: spec by Apr 8, canary infra by Apr 15, pilot with Customer H late Apr. Can someone add this to the roadmap board?
aj: Adding to the roadmap board now. Tagging @design for console mockups and @sales for pilot scheduling.
tanya: I'll draft the comms and a short FAQ for pilot customers, will circulate for review tomorrow.
mel: Thanks — I'll write a one-pager summarizing gates + owners and share in #product later today. :thumbsup:
